title: edmdc-tank-observables: observable dictionaries for Koopman-EDMDc identification of a laboratory tank
description: Code and results of a comparison of observable dictionaries for the identification of a laboratory-scale tank level system with extended dynamic mode decomposition with control (EDMDc). The repository reproduces every result, table and figure of the paper "What Does a Physics-Derived Observable Add to Generic EDMDc Dictionaries? A Nested Comparison on a Laboratory Tank" (CCIA 2026).
